hero.hero_quote: Bringing nature's finest directly to your table since generations.

story.title: How It All Began
story.description_1: Arion was founded by a family who watched the food they trusted slowly disappear from shelves, replaced by colourful packaging and invisible chemicals.
story.description_2: We set out to change that. Not loudly, not with slogans, but quietly — the way good food has always worked. One pure product, one trusted source, one honest jar at a time.
story.description_3: Today, every Arion product carries that same original conviction: that the best food is the least interfered with, and that the wisdom of our grandmothers was never something to improve upon — only to protect.

problems.title: Loss of Natural Food Quality
problems.description: Industrial sourcing and mass production eroded the nutritional depth of everyday foods across generations.

problems.title: Rise of Artificial Products
problems.description: Preservatives, additives, and synthetic flavours became the norm — prioritising shelf life over human life.

problems.title: Health Awareness Growing
problems.description: A global shift in consciousness began. People started asking harder questions about what they were actually eating.

problems.title: Return to Pure Traditions
problems.description: Arion was born here — to honour what was lost and return it, with trust and full transparency, to your table.

mission.title: Our Core Mission
mission.description: Every decision we make is guided by four uncompromising principles that have shaped Arion since the very beginning.

core_values.title: Purity First
core_values.description: We prioritise natural, unprocessed ingredients. Nothing enters our products that we would not give our own children.

core_values.title: Trust & Transparency
core_values.description: What you see is what you get — no hidden compromises, no ambiguous labels, no grey areas.

core_values.title: Traditional Wisdom
core_values.description: Inspired by generations of natural healing practices refined across centuries of lived experience.

core_values.title: Modern Wellness
core_values.description: Blending time-tested tradition with contemporary nutritional science for measurably better living.
